title: Additive correction to the useful-lock evaluator after review of d64a598
frozen_before: any corrected measurement or corrected evidence generation

base_protocol.note: The original frozen protocol is NOT edited. This correction is additive and only enforces what the original protocol already declares.

original_evidence.note: Original traces/results/provenance are preserved byte-for-byte; no corrected measurement overwrites them.

findings.F1: protocol declares a generated provenance marker must reject a real claim, but validate_manifest/gate_eligibility ignored provenance. A real-class recording with a generated provenance marker and a matching trace could pass the gate.
findings.F2: a trace loaded from the requested backend directory could declare a different backend or a derived kind and still count for the real gate.
findings.F3: the derived candidate recorded an all-zero placeholder tool_sha256 instead of hashing the actual producer implementation.
findings.F4: the phase window was hard-coded to two bars instead of using criteria.acquisition_window_bars.

changes.change: validate_manifest emits hard provenance_contradicts_real and gate_eligibility excludes a real recording whose declared provenance/tags contain a generated/synthetic marker (synthes*, generated, synthetic, machine-generated, not a human performance/recording, programmatic, karplus, rendered by).
changes.trust_boundary: classification, ownership, license and provenance are DECLARED fields. The check is a declaration-consistency rule, not proof about the PCM: no offline byte check can mathematically attest that a recording is a human performance. Audio identity (sha256/rate/duration) is verified; human origin is trusted from the declaration.

changes.change: validate_trace binds expected_backend/expected_kind/expected_parent; the CLI requires real kind for a real backend and derived-from-btrack for the candidate; evaluate_gate independently fails closed unless every gate score has backend == the requested backend and backend_kind == 'real', so a direct call cannot bypass the binding.
derive_beat_interval_trace records sha256 of the actual producer source; validate_trace rejects all-zero placeholder tool hashes (not merely non-64-hex).

the phase-usability window is computed from criteria.acquisition_window_bars * meter.beats_per_bar instead of a hard-coded 2 bars. With the frozen defaults this is numerically identical; the correction matters when the window is varied.
host-absolute defaults (tracker-diagnostics binary, backend libs, protocol, workdir) can be overridden via GLE_TRACKER_DIAGNOSTICS, GLE_BTRACK_LIB, GLE_AUBIO_LIB, GLE_PROTOCOL, GLE_WORKDIR.

corrected_measurements.evidence_class: diagnostic synthetic baseline, corrected; real-guitar G3 gate still fails closed (no representative real recordings)
corrected_measurements.no_change_to_default_numbers: F1/F2 do not apply to the all-synthetic baseline and F4 is a no-op at the frozen default window; the only expected artifact change is the candidate producer hash and wall-clock timestamps.
